ValidationRule.description: CR-14: quote currency and regional price book must match the account Region (NA USD, UK GBP, AU AUD, EU EUR). Skipped when the Region is blank.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Opportunity.Account.MB_Region__c))), OR( TEXT(CurrencyIsoCode) <> CASE(TEXT(Opportunity.Account.MB_Region__c), 'NA', 'USD', 'UK', 'GBP', 'AU', 'AUD', 'EU', 'EUR', TEXT(CurrencyIsoCode)), AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Pricebook2Id)), CONTAINS(Pricebook2.Name, '('), NOT(CONTAINS(Pricebook2.Name, '(' & CASE(TEXT(Opportunity.Account.MB_Region__c), 'NA', 'USD', 'UK', 'GBP', 'AU', 'AUD', 'EU', 'EUR', '') & ')')) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The quote's currency and price book must match the account's Region: NA = USD, UK = GBP, AU = AUD, EU = EUR.
